components.name: Secondary upload button
components.css: .ds-upload-button { font: 12px/1.5 "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; color: var(--ink, #dcdfe1); background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--line, #3b3f43); border-radius: 5px; padding: 8px 10px; min-height: 38px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-upload-button:hover { background: var(--soft, #2b3034); color: var(--accent, #95bdd0); } .ds-upload-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #7caac0); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-upload-button:disabled { cursor: default; opacity: .4; }

components.name: Primary save button
components.description: Local preview keeps the save action disabled; this sample shows that state.
components.css: .ds-save { font: 12px/1.5 "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; color: var(--ink, #dcdfe1); background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--line, #3b3f43); border-radius: 5px; padding: 8px 10px; min-height: 38px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-save:hover { background: var(--soft, #2b3034); color: var(--accent, #95bdd0); } .ds-save:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #7caac0); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-save:disabled { cursor: default; opacity: .4; } .ds-save, .ds-save:hover { background: var(--accent, #95bdd0); border-color: var(--accent, #95bdd0); color: var(--page, #1d1e20); } :host-context(body[data-theme="light"]) .ds-save { color: #fff; }

components.name: Caption field
components.description: Labeled field used for selected-photo captions.
components.html: <label class="ds-caption">Caption for photo 1<input type="text" placeholder="A moment to remember (optional)"></label>
components.css: .ds-caption { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; color: var(--ink, #dcdfe1); font: 12px/1.5 "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; } .ds-caption input { font: inherit; color: inherit; width: 100%; min-height: 38px; background: var(--page, #1d1e20); border: 1px solid var(--line, #3b3f43); border-radius: 5px; padding: 8px 10px; caret-color: var(--accent, #95bdd0); } .ds-caption input::placeholder { color: var(--ink, #dcdfe1); opacity: .7; } .ds-caption input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #7caac0); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: City navigation
components.description: Small text controls with a quiet active surface.
components.html: <nav class="ds-nav" aria-label="Map views"><button class="ds-nav-item ds-active" aria-pressed="true">Cities</button><button class="ds-nav-item" aria-pressed="false">Timeline</button><button class="ds-nav-item" aria-pressed="false">Overview</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 5px; align-items: center; } .ds-nav-item { border: 0; border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 13px; background: transparent; color: var(--muted, #92989d); font: 12px/1.5 "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav-item:hover { color: var(--accent, #95bdd0); } .ds-nav-item.ds-active { color: var(--ink, #dcdfe1); background: var(--soft, #2b3034); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #7caac0); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Visit-month chip
components.description: Informational date label, without an interactive selected state.
components.css: .ds-month { display: inline-block; padding: 6px 8px; border-radius: 4px; color: var(--ink, #dcdfe1); background: var(--soft, #2b3034); font: 11px/1.5 "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: City record row
components.description: A divided text row inside the city panel; sample labels are illustrative.
components.css: .ds-panel-sample { background: var(--paper, rgba(30, 33, 36, .97)); padding: 0 15px 0 20px; } .ds-city { display: block; width: 100%; text-align: left; padding: 15px 2px; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #3b3f43); background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #dcdfe1); font-family: "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-city:hover { background: var(--soft, #2b3034); } .ds-city-title { display: block; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-city-date { display: block; margin-top: 5px; font-size: 10px; color: var(--muted, #92989d); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-city:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #7caac0); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Photo drop target
components.description: The inherited upload surface; the live implementation also accepts dropped files.
components.css: .ds-drop { width: 100%; min-height: 126px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 5px; padding: 20px 12px; border: 1px dashed var(--muted, #92989d); border-radius: 7px; background: var(--page, #1d1e20); color: var(--ink, #dcdfe1); font-family: "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-drop strong { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-drop span { font-size: 13px; color: var(--accent, #95bdd0); text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 3px; } .ds-drop small { margin-top: 5px; font-size: 11px; opacity: .75; } .ds-drop:hover { color: var(--accent, #95bdd0); } .ds-drop.ds-dragging { border-style: solid; border-color: var(--accent, #95bdd0); background: var(--soft, #2b3034); } .ds-drop:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #7caac0); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-drop:disabled { cursor: default; opacity: .4; }

components.name: Wishlist marker
components.description: A hollow champagne ring whose border-box stays equal to a resting visited dot in every interaction state.
components.css: .ds-wish-pin { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 18px; height: 18px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; } .ds-wish-dot, .ds-wish-pin:hover .ds-wish-dot, .ds-wish-pin:focus-visible .ds-wish-dot, .ds-wish-pin.ds-selected .ds-wish-dot { display: block; width: 6px; height: 6px; box-sizing: border-box; border: 1px solid var(--wish); border-radius: 50%; background: transparent; box-shadow: none; } .ds-wish-pin:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Wishlist city search
components.description: Inline destination search with quiet country filters and a divided result row; sample city labels are illustrative.
components.css: .ds-wish-search { color: var(--ink); font: 12px/1.65 "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } :host-context(body[data-theme="light"]) .ds-wish-search { --muted: #59646b; } .ds-wish-search-label { display: grid; font-size: 12px; } .ds-wish-search-input { min-width: 0; margin: 7px 0 12px; min-height: 40px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--soft); color: var(--ink); padding: 8px 10px; font: inherit; caret-color: var(--wish); } .ds-wish-search-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted); opacity: 1; } .ds-wish-filters { display: flex; gap: 6px; flex-wrap: wrap; } .ds-wish-filter { border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; min-height: 36px; padding: 7px 10px; font: 11px/1.65 "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; color: var(--ink); background: transparent; cursor: pointer; } .ds-wish-filter[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--soft); border-color: var(--line); } .ds-wish-result { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 12px; width: 100%; text-align: left; padding: 14px 2px; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); background: transparent; color: var(--ink); font: inherit; cursor: pointer; } .ds-wish-symbol { display: inline-block; width: 6px; height: 6px; box-sizing: border-box; border: 1px solid var(--wish); border-radius: 50%; flex: 0 0 6px; margin-top: 8px; } .ds-wish-result-copy { display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-width: 0; } .ds-wish-result strong { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-wish-result small { font-size: 10px; color: var(--muted); margin-top: 3px; } .ds-wish-filter:hover, .ds-wish-result:hover { background: var(--soft); color: var(--accent); } .ds-wish-search-input:focus-visible, .ds-wish-filter:focus-visible, .ds-wish-result:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-wish-filter:disabled, .ds-wish-result:disabled { cursor: default; opacity: .4; } @media (max-width: 760px) { .ds-wish-search-input { font-size: 16px; } .ds-wish-filter { min-height: 40px; } }

components.name: Wishlist display preference
components.description: A native checkbox and hollow-mark legend that remain outside the collapsible city panel.
components.css: .ds-wish-visibility { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 36px; padding: 7px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); font: 11px/1.5 "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-wish-checkbox { accent-color: var(--wish); width: 14px; height: 14px; margin: 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-wish-legend { display: inline-block; width: 6px; height: 6px; box-sizing: border-box; border: 1px solid var(--wish); border-radius: 50%; flex: 0 0 6px; } .ds-wish-checkbox:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; } @media (max-width: 760px) { .ds-wish-visibility { min-height: 33px; padding: 6px 8px; font-size: 10px; gap: 6px; } } @media (max-width: 380px) { .ds-wish-visibility { gap: 5px; } }

narrative.overview:
The world map carries the visual weight. Dark gray land and water establish a restrained field; tiny cyan dots mark places without turning the map into a collection of oversized pins. Compact records sit in a collapsible panel, leaving the map available for exploration.

The photo dialog inherits this existing world: neutral surfaces, fine borders, modest curves, plain controls, and a cyan primary action. English is the default, with a Chinese toggle. This record describes the current source in `site/styles.css`, `index.html`, `site/app.js`, and `site/photo-upload.js`; it does not certify rendered quality or deployed upload behavior.

The public wishlist extends the same atlas with hollow champagne marks and compact destination records. Browsing, city search, and owner editing stay inside the existing panel; a separate map control keeps wishlist visibility available when that panel is collapsed. These additions follow `site/wishlist.css`, `site/wishlist-view.js`, and the wishlist integration in `site/app.js`.
keyCharacteristics: Gray map surfaces with a restrained cyan accent.
Small circular markers and compact, collapsible records.
Shared neutral controls across browsing and photo preparation.
Explicit state text alongside disabled controls.
Hollow champagne wishlist marks alongside cyan visits.

rules.name: The Quiet Accent Rule
rules.body: Keep the geographic field neutral; use cyan for places, actions, and focus.

rules.name: The Wishlist Accent Rule
rules.body: Reserve champagne for wishlist identity and its display control; wishlist actions retain the shared neutral surfaces and cyan keyboard focus.

rules.name: The Shared Surface Rule
rules.body: New overlays inherit the existing surface, border, and shadow tokens.

dos: **Do** preserve the gray map, tiny cyan dots, and collapsible city panel.
**Do** reuse CSS color variables so controls follow both existing themes.
**Do** retain English and Chinese labels, visible focus, and explicit state text.
**Do** keep wishlist rings equal in outer size to resting visited dots, including their border.
**Do** keep the wishlist visibility control usable while the city panel is collapsed.
donts: **Don't** introduce a separate visual identity for the upload dialog.
**Don't** replace small place dots with oversized pins.
**Don't** present local previews or repository saves as confirmed website publication.
**Don't** fill or enlarge unvisited wishlist rings during hover, focus, or selection.
**Don't** give wishlist search and owner editing a separate overlay or visual identity.
